title: Q7 Assessment Item provider-contract supplemental replay

defectClasses.summary: Assessment Item provider candidates can omit subquestion maxMark, requirementIds and coverageEvidence before the strict assessment compiler reaches its existing bounded repair path.
defectClasses.syntheticBasis: Replay the exact omission family independently and simultaneously across all five governed subject shapes. Preserve model ownership of educational subquestion structure, allow only omission to cross the first provider-candidate boundary, collect deterministic strict-schema diagnostics, perform at most one targeted repair, then revalidate the complete Assessment Item and fail closed if any required field remains absent.
